# Catalog schema

<!-- Generated by `pnpm schema:generate` from apps/web/src/catalog/domain/schema/. Do not edit; `pnpm schema:check` (gate) fails when it is stale. -->

One source for every catalog id, slug, label limit and default (CONTRACT.md INV-R1). The bundle validator and the admin
route contracts both derive from `src/catalog/domain/schema/`, so an id the API refuses is refused in a bundle too.

A lesson lasts at most 86400 s. A known edition year is 1990–2100.

## Defaults

| Field | When omitted |
|---|---|
| `lessonNoun` | `"Lecture"` |
| `lessonPart` | `"lectures"` |
| `editionYear` | `null` |

An edition without a year keeps `null` (unknown); a year is never invented. Writing such an edition is refused until
the year is named.

## CourseBundleV1

`version` is `1`. Absent or null collections are empty (merge, not deletion).

### `author`

| Field | Type | Required | Limits | Default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes | ≤ 64 chars, `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |  |
| `slug` | string | yes | ≤ 120 chars, `^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$` |  |
| `name` | string | yes | ≥ 1 chars, ≤ 120 chars |  |
| `monogram` | string | yes | ≥ 1 chars, ≤ 3 chars |  |
| `kind` | `"person"` · `"institution"` · `"channel"` | yes |  |  |
